title: ElderSummaryV1
description: Minimal elder profile returned by GET /api/v1/elders/{elder_id}. Per ADR-10-005 this DTO is deliberately NOT the database entity: language, communication and care preferences, plus every identifier of related records, are withheld.

display_name.description: Display name. Demo and test data must be synthetic or de-identified.

primary_care_setting.description: Primary care setting. Mirrors the elder.primary_care_setting CHECK constraint in the eldercare_ai schema.
